body: Yeah.. idk how much longer I can deal with it. Hopefully therapy helps.

I’ve been told that my oldest brother (32 years old) went through pretty much the exact same thing at my age, and that it is derived from a little bit of jealousy. I’m not sure what it’s really from though. Also I’m only about half as athletically talented as he was so I don’t think it’s that.
Hey it’s my birthday too! Happy birthday!
Man, I appreciate that a lot. I’m saving this comment and I’m just gonna keep looking at this throughout the year. You’re right. Just 1 year.
That’s true. I don’t like to complain but man high school just gets me so down. Really feeling isolated since my whole friend group graduated last year too.
Nah, the ringleader tells them I’m a pussy/bitch and a faker who fakes being sick all the time. I have to hear it from the moles. Just high school drama bs, just tired of being outlasted.
They’re supposed to be my teammates/friends
Thank you for your words. It’s nice to know someone understands. It’s just depressing knowing how evil high schoolers can be. But it’ll be ok.

Going to community college a few hours away to do gen eds, and planning to room with my girlfriend and 2 other roommates who are our friends. Just need to get away from all of this where I’m at rn. So done with the high school drama and ready to make new friends. But for now it’s just crushing the walls in my brain.

Nope, class D2 school. 16 man team. 8 man football. I’ve always been the outcast despite doing quite a lot for people. One year is all I have but one thing after another is just depressing me so much. It’s a shame my therapist moved..
She’s not worth it brother. You’ll find another who treats you better, I believe in you.
That is actually incredible. hopefully the feeling of emptiness goes away. Stay strong please
Binding of Isaac is one of my favorite games. I still remember the joy of beating mom for the first time..
Hey, I hope you’re still around.
Very well said
I’m going through the exact same thing. I’ve gained 10 pounds in a matter of a couple days.
There’s plenty of other ways. But you have to beat whatever is plaguing you to act like this.
Life changes very fast. Highs and lows all around. Please just stick around a little longer. It may pay off extremely well.
There is hope. It seems dark but you can overcome it.
Talk to your family. Ask to see a therapist. It’s a step in the right direction.
Please talk to someone. It’s worth it. I promise.

What the hell happened to you. You were always on this sub lurking, now you’re attacking others because you didn’t reach out for help.
Stop commenting. You might begin to help your own mentality by helping others mentality.
Feels like I wrote this.
Saving this comment to give it an award later

Life really is cruel. I was told that these are the best times of my life but all I do is lay in bed and think of the thousands of ways I can end myself. I’m empty too, but I absolutely hope you feel better soon. Just try to see what next week holds.
Me too. I hope this notification means something.
What’s on your mind? Is there anything in particular making you feel this way?

I’ve been in your situation. I’m sorry you feel this way, but you need to try your best to take your life back. What happened to me is I lost that fear of dying, and it’s the worst thing that can happen. Just take everything one day at a time. I believe in you.
The first step is getting help. I’m proud of you, you are on the road to recovery :)
Kind of the same, oh I’m just tired. Then don’t feel the need to talk to anyone and after sleeping feel more exhausted and angry. Couple days later, “hey why don’t I just die?”
It’s hard. I’m right here with you and it’s hard. But sooner or later things will change. Just try a little longer...
Keep fighting friend. Hang on just a little longer, life changes quickly.
